title: Making a finite morphism over an affine base locally free by a finite locally free base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a finite morphism with affine base, a base change that is surjective finite locally free and over which the pullback of the source embeds as a closed subscheme of a finite locally free scheme which is a finite union of closed subschemes each mapping isomorphically to the new base. The proof writes both schemes as spectra of rings, chooses generators of the algebra with monic polynomial relations, adjoins all the roots of those polynomials in a finite locally free extension, and takes the quotient of a polynomial ring over that extension by the relations; the five numbered assertions are read off from the construction, the last one from the explicit ideals cutting out the components.
